$description: AssistantHero component contract (wave-IX IX.2) — the authored hero window on MAIN and assistant screens. Pinned: substrate and palette derive from always-dark authored roles (surface.art / accent.onArt) so the hero reads identically on light and dark themes — the image is part of the artwork, not a themed card.

substrate.$description: Hero window ground — always-dark authored stage, theme-invariant.

gold.$description: Hero accent gold — pinned authored gold (#C9A45C family), replaces the hardcoded --gold in alice-hero.module.css.

goldSoft.$description: Portrait rings / subtle gold strokes (was rgba(201,164,92,0.4)).

wash.$description: Warm top wash over the substrate (was rgba(237,221,196,0.04)).

glowRadial.$description: Radial bloom at the portrait well (was rgba(218,175,102,0.2)).

halo.$description: Outer halo around the hero window (was 0 0 42px rgba(201,164,92,.16)).

haloInner.$description: Inner vignette glow inside the hero window.

portraitGlow.$description: Glow behind the circular portrait image (was 0 0 34px rgba(201,164,92,.28)).

radius.$description: Hero window corner — 16px, generous feature-panel radius (was 18px literal).

portraitSize.$description: Circular portrait diameter in the circle variant.
